_about: Карточки моделей для ассистента. Ключ = id из INTEGRATED_MODELS. Факты — со страниц моделей и notes в server.py. params — ТОЛЬКО то, что /api/generate реально передаёт модели (см. INTEGRATION_PROMPT.md, шаг 3). Цены здесь не хранятся — берутся из прайса в момент ответа.
_modes: t2v (текст→видео), i2v (фото→видео), t2i (текст→картинка), i2i (правка фото), t2m (текст→музыка/звук)

seedance-2-5.title: Seedance 2.5

strengths.en: video with synced audio, up to 30 s

seedance-2-5.prompt_style: English. Subject, action, setting, lighting, one camera move at the end (e.g. 'slow dolly-in'). Mention sounds briefly if relevant. 1-3 sentences.

wan-3-0.title: Wan 3.0
wan-3-0.prompt_style: English. Clear subject + action + setting + light; one camera instruction. Short, concrete sentences.

veo-3-1.title: Veo 3.1
veo-3-1.prompt_style: English cinematic shot description: shot type, subject, action, setting, light, mood. Dialogue in double quotes with the speaker. End with a line 'Audio: ...' for ambience/SFX.

veo-3-1-fast.title: Veo 3.1 Fast
veo-3-1-fast.prompt_style: English cinematic shot description: shot type, subject, action, setting, light. Dialogue in double quotes with the speaker. Optional line 'Audio: ...'.

kling-v2-5-turbo-pro.title: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro
kling-v2-5-turbo-pro.prompt_style: English. Describe motion: what moves, how, and the camera path; keep subject identity. 1-3 short sentences.

pixverse-v6.title: PixVerse V6
pixverse-v6.prompt_style: English. Style first (e.g. 'anime', '3D clay'), then subject, action, setting, camera. Short sentences.

p-video.title: P-Video

strengths.en: very cheap drafts, up to 20 s

p-video.prompt_style: English. One or two simple sentences: subject, action, setting.

hailuo-02.title: Hailuo 02
hailuo-02.prompt_style: English, action-first. Camera moves in square brackets, e.g. [Push in], [Pan left].

grok-imagine-video-1-5.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5

limits.en: photo input only, up to 15 s

grok-imagine-video-1-5.prompt_style: English. Describe only the motion and sound to add to the image; do not re-describe the image.

gen4-turbo.title: Gen-4 Turbo
gen4-turbo.prompt_style: English. Motion only: subject motion + camera motion. Do not re-describe the image.

seedream-5-pro.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro
seedream-5-pro.prompt_style: English: subject, materials, composition, lens/light, palette. Exact on-image text in double quotes.

gpt-image-2.title: GPT Image 2
gpt-image-2.prompt_style: Natural English brief: purpose, layout (top/center/bottom), elements, style; exact text in double quotes.

gpt-image-2-5-flare.title: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
gpt-image-2-5-flare.prompt_style: Natural English brief: purpose, layout, elements, style; exact text in double quotes.

gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.title: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.prompt_style: Natural English brief: purpose, layout, elements, style; exact text in double quotes.

nano-banana-2.title: Nano Banana 2

strengths.en: edits photos by text, blends images

nano-banana-2.prompt_style: Imperative English edit instruction: what to change and what to keep (face, pose, style). One sentence per change.

ideogram-v3-turbo.title: Ideogram v3 Turbo
ideogram-v3-turbo.prompt_style: English: design type (logo/poster/banner), exact text in double quotes, font feel, layout, colors, background.

ace-step.title: ACE-Step
ace-step.prompt_style: Comma-separated English tags only: genre, mood, instruments, tempo in bpm. No sentences.

elevenlabs-music.title: ElevenLabs Music

strengths.ru: треки с вокалом или без, для рекламы
strengths.en: tracks with or without vocals, ad-ready

elevenlabs-music.prompt_style: Natural English: genre, mood, use-case, instruments, tempo, structure (intro/build/drop), vocals or instrumental.

stable-audio-2-5.title: Stable Audio 2.5

strengths.en: sounds and music up to 190 s

stable-audio-2-5.prompt_style: English sound description: source, texture, space/reverb, BPM for loops, length.
